sources.price: OpenCode Go published rates (deepseek, glm, mimo, luna); Anthropic first-party rates for claude-haiku-5-5 (prompts up to 100K tokens). OpenAI GPT-family (Sol, Terra, Luna, Astra) on the DSH openai-codex route: DSH-bundled pi-ai openai API price table (@earendil-works/pi-ai providers/data/openai.json, openai-responses), checked against public pricing listings 2026-10-18; theoretical list price, not the ChatGPT subscription charge.
sources.notes: prior = short public or catalog facts, not measurements; it is the cold-start basis and is weighed below measured data and the workspace adaptation ledger. measured = dsh-bench executor runs: 12 SWE-bench Verified pytest tasks, 600 s and 64 model calls per task, single agent and native subagents pooled over 2 runs (48 cases).
